preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE table_name = 'promotion' AND constraint_name = 'promotion_type_check' AND constraint_type = 'CHECK'

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE promotion DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS promotion_type_check;

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE promotion ADD CONSTRAINT promotion_type_check CHECK (type::text = ANY (ARRAY['DISCOUNT'::character varying, 'GENERIC'::character varying, 'COMBO'::character varying]::text[]));
